invariants.rationale: context is expected to be provided for engine operations; null context would likely cause errors.
instantTime is typically a required parameter representing a commit or operation time and should not be null or empty.
hoodieRecords is a main input and is expected to be non-null for upsert operations.
upserting with an empty list is typically not meaningful; many pipelines skip no-op transactions.
instantTime should not be just whitespace; validity checks usually enforce this.
